visual.general_description: Four photographed paper ECG printouts labelled A to D arranged in a two-by-two grid.
visual.detailed_description: A 2 by 2 arrangement of four photographed paper electrocardiograms with different background tones and lighting. Panel letters A, B, C and D are printed in black near the lower left of each panel. Each printout has several lead rows and a bottom rhythm strip; lead labels and calibration text are too small to read. A and B show broad rounded waves in the right-hand segments of the lead rows, C shows narrow spikes with baseline variation, and D shows regularly spaced narrow complexes in six lead rows. No patient identifiers are legible.

panels.general_description: Photograph of a paper ECG printout with three lead rows and a long rhythm strip, labelled A.
panels.detailed_description: A photographed paper ECG with a grey-brown background tone. Three stacked lead rows run across the page, each divided into segments by small lead labels that are too small to read; a long single-lead rhythm strip runs along the bottom. In the left segments of each row the trace is low-amplitude and fairly flat; in the right segments the complexes become broader with large rounded deflections. A faint grid is visible only in places. The letter "A" is printed in black at the lower left of the panel. No patient name, date or other readable text is visible.

visual.general_description: A test results table with 15 analyte rows and 12 time columns from Pre-EICU to D81.
visual.detailed_description: A black-on-white table with a bold header row: Tests, Pre-EICU, D0, D1, D2, D3, D4, D11, D14, D20, D27, D50 and D81. Fifteen rows list pH, Lactate (mmol/L), Platelet (10^9/L), Hemoglobin (g/dL), Hematocrit (%), ALT (U/L), TBil (µmol/L), Urea (mg/dL), Creatinine (µmol/L), Troponin (ng/dL), C-reactive protein (mg/L), ScvO2 (%), EF (%), MAP (mm Hg) and Pulse pressure (mm Hg). Every printed numeric cell is transcribed in chart readings; empty cells are printed as dashes. Some cells print comparators: EF prints <10 under D2, >50 under D11 and >60 under D14; C-reactive protein prints <1 under D27. The EF row prints 67 under D50 and a dash under D81. A footer defines ALT, EF, MAP, pH, ScvO2 and TBil. No colour coding, arrows or trend curves are present.
